info.title: MyScoutee access permissions
info.description: Explicit bounded calls to the native AccessControlService. These return policy decisions and never perform protected mutations. Service capability and REAL/DEMO context are mandatory. If an end-user actor is present, an operation/body-bound identity-issued proof is mandatory and installed around the owner call. Absence is evaluated with an empty user security context, preserving the native member-fallback / DEMO decision; the service credential is never treated as a user. Invalid proof is rejected, never downgraded to absence. Authentication extraction and resource-state scope conversion reuse canonical API defaults; full Spring Authentication or asset/resource documents are never serialized. 64 KiB requests / 16 KiB replies, no retries.
